That is evidence the primary assertion is load-bearing, not a runner-level mutant kill, so I am not scoring it PASS. - **V4 write proof:** the only write is the app's auto-save to IndexedDB (`gridfinity-db` → `layouts`, opaque compressed string; no HTTP write exists for this flow). The spec polls the record until it differs from the pre-click snapshot, then reloads — discarding all in-memory optimistic state — and re-asserts cardinality exactly 1 plus the same summary. **PASS.** The separate injected-failed-write *run* was not performed (allowlist), but the post-reload assertions are what a failed write would falsify. - **V5 repeat/isolation:** 3× solo runs of the approved command, all green, no retries.
